title: New: Trillion notices on your iPhone and Apple Watch
summary: Your iPhone and Apple Watch now get Trillion's notices, with Reply and Open right on them, and running work shows on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

payload.title: Notices on your iPhone
payload.body: Open the Trillion app on your iPhone once and allow notifications. From then on, what your AIs tell you reaches your iPhone and Apple Watch.

payload.title: Answer without opening anything
payload.body: Press and hold a notice to see Reply and Open. Type a reply on the Lock Screen and it goes to your AIs as your message.

payload.title: Watch work as it runs
payload.body: Exports, copies and other long work show their progress on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island until they finish.
